thread:
incident-bot: PAGING — HIGH latency detected on inference-service-prod (us-west-1). Pager triggered to #oncall. Incident ID PGR-2026-04-12-01.

alex: I'm on it, joining the bridge now.

maria: Looking at autoscaler and GPU utilization. Seeing queuing on worker pods.

sam: Customer reports: increased 503s and timeouts around 03:08–03:12. Prefix cache miss rate spiked.

ana: (typo fixed) ana: Spinning up an extra warm pool and switching a subset of traffic to fallback-model-small to reduce token compute.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/PGR-2026-04-12-01

alex: Mitigation actions: +5 GPUs to ded. pool, cleared KV cache on nodes A-C, routing rule applied to route 20% traffic to fallback-model-small. 95th latency dropping from ~2.5s -> ~1.2s.

ryan: Quick customer-impact note: several enterprise customers saw degraded response times; a small subset experienced client-side timeouts >15s. No authentication or data exfil indications so far.

kari: Creating incident record and queuing for postmortem. Adding initial tags: latency, autoscaler, model-rollout.

sam: I see a correlation with the quantized-model rollout at 03:10 — new variant 7a3b2 went live. Can we rollback that variant?

maria: Rolling back to model commit 7a2f9 now. Will watch metrics.

alex: After rollback, p95 returned to baseline within ~6 minutes. Rolling through logs to capture exact timeline.

ana: ana: Scheduling ask — can we set a postmortem review tomorrow 10:00 PT? @maria @sam @ryan please confirm availability.

kari: :thumbsup: I'll create the doc and calendar invite.

kari: Postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/PGR-2026-04-12-01 (draft created, permissions open to eng & support).

sam: I'll draft the RCA timeline and list contributing factors. Please assign peer reviewers.

alex: Happy to peer review and add notes on rollout gating.

maria: I'll review observability/alarms section — we should add autoscaler threshold re-eval and canary metric.

ryan: I'll prepare the customer impact blurb for legal/comms and confirm there was no PII exposure.

incident-bot: Pager closed by alex. Duration: 28 minutes. Attached logs and metrics: https://logs.redwood/ingest/PGR-2026-04-12-01

kari: Owners assigned in tracker: RCA draft — sam; Peer review — alex, maria; Remediation (release gating & CI tests) — alex; Observability & alarms — maria; Legal impact statement — ryan.

sam: Drafted RCA (doc tag draft-1). Highlights: quantized model rollout lacked canary for prefix-miss metric, autoscaler didn't trigger fast enough under sudden KV-cache miss pattern.

alex: Left inline comments: add exact timestamps, attach p95/p99 graphs, include the affected customer IDs (anonymized) and retry counts.

maria: Also recommend adding a short-runbook to rollback quantized variants — probably a one-click flag.

ryan: Legal review in progress, will confirm final wording by EOD.

kari: Plan after peer signoff: produce exec summary, action-item tracker with due dates, and schedule follow-up verification in two weeks to confirm mitigations.

ana: ana: Thanks all — good triage. Postmortem meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT, invite sent. Please review draft before the meeting so we can sign off and close actions.

alex: Thanks team, will follow up with remediation PR and add CI gate tickets.
